definitions.explanation: A mushroom that contains toxins harmful or fatal to humans when consumed.

examples.japanese: {毒茸|どくきのこ}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please watch out for poisonous mushrooms.

examples.japanese: {毒茸|どくきのこ}と{食用|しょくよう}きのこは{見分|みわ}けにくい。
examples.english: Poisonous and edible mushrooms are hard to tell apart.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{秋|あき}になると{毒茸|どくきのこ}を{食|た}べて{中毒|ちゅうどく}になる{事故|じこ}が{起|お}きる。
examples.english: Every autumn, there are incidents of poisoning from eating toxic mushrooms.

notes:
Composed of {毒|どく} (poison) + {茸|きのこ} (mushroom). Also sometimes read as どくたけ. Japan has numerous species of poisonous wild mushrooms, making this a practical vocabulary word during mushroom-hunting season in autumn.

COMMON POISONOUS SPECIES IN JAPAN:
- ツキヨタケ: moon night mushroom — the most common cause of mushroom poisoning in Japan
- ドクツルタケ: destroying angel — one of the most deadly
- カエンタケ: fire mushroom — toxic even to touch

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒茸|どくきのこ}に{中毒|ちゅうどく}する: to be poisoned by a toxic mushroom
- {毒茸|どくきのこ}を{見分|みわ}ける: to distinguish poisonous mushrooms
- {毒茸|どくきのこ}{中毒|ちゅうどく}: mushroom poisoning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食用|しょくよう}きのこ: edible mushroom — the safe counterpart
- きのこ{狩|が}り: mushroom hunting — the activity where knowledge of {毒茸|どくきのこ} matters
- {毒草|どくそう}: poisonous plant — the broader plant category
